notes.title: ‼️PATCH UPDATE: Foodomina Demo v1.1‼️✨️🍰
notes.notes: [h3][b]ᯓ✦ [/b]Hello Gamers! We hope you've been enjoying the demo![/h3][p][/p][p]We've got some new updates ready to play that make it even better! This is our first of many demo updates we have planned, so grab your snacks and take a read at what's changed! 🍿✨️[/p][p][/p][p]୧ ‧₊˚ [b]NEW FEATURES:[/b][/p][p] ▪︎ New Dialogue Animations[/p][p]▪︎ Sneak peak of new content in development at the END[/p][p]▪︎ Ability to pat Tempura [/p][p]▪︎ Setting to disable Battle Timers [/p][p]▪︎ Setting to highlight or colour code Cure Hints [/p][p][/p][p]୧ ‧₊˚ [b]CHANGELOG:[/b][/p][p]▪︎ General Bug Fixes [/p][p]▪︎ Fixed some typos & sentence structures[/p][p]▪︎ Dialogue UI Overhaul for New Animations [/p][p]▪︎ Updated visuals & VFX for improved UX in battles[/p][p]▪︎ All game testers from last year (2024) who provided their names have been included in the [b]game credits[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/06052841499986bbf4a5ec88835d99495c77fa7e.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/06052841499986bbf4a5ec88835d99495c77fa7e.gif"][/img][/url][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/78b8b48583fdf4abd5500d4957c2c2df72ddb40b.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/78b8b48583fdf4abd5500d4957c2c2df72ddb40b.gif"][/img][/url]             [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/1a916f05dd0877a9cebd86184f0c950d8f443eef.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/1a916f05dd0877a9cebd86184f0c950d8f443eef.gif"][/img][/url][/p][h3]If you play the demo, please share your thoughts through these feedback surveys!💫[/h3][p][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/uvHf9vTsXxWAMHFm8" style="button" buttoncolor="#c21aff"]Story Mode Feedback Survey[/url][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/sB3dgzAf9fpsrFGX8" style="button" buttoncolor="#005751"]Battle Mode Feedback Survey[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]If any of you take a peak at the [i]development teasers[/i] at the end... we hope you like what we have in store! If you want to know more, we will be sharing our development and getting [i]OUR COMMUNITY[/i] involved in a lot of it with suggestions & ideas, on our [b]socials![/b]🍤🐙[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://linktr.ee/foodomina" style="button" buttoncolor="#341aff"]Foodomina Socials[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Have fun! ᯓ✦[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/c1d87d1dbb7ec03f18fe097b7116ec8059c10223.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/c1d87d1dbb7ec03f18fe097b7116ec8059c10223.gif"][/img][/url][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/1e0b5543e6c84cb698b653399f1c3f9f8b3d56ae.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/1e0b5543e6c84cb698b653399f1c3f9f8b3d56ae.gif"][/img][/url]    [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/6e04f92e89deab246e1bc9189c6c41acbe4b7693.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/6e04f92e89deab246e1bc9189c6c41acbe4b7693.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p]
